narrNote: FARR is listed as Florida's affiliate on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates), fetched and read in-run on 2026-10-22.
notes: Agency URL is DCF SAMH's substance-abuse treatment page (fetched 200, content match); the phone shown is the SAMH Program Office number published on that page (Tallahassee). DCF's older /service-programs/samh/ path returns 404; current SAMH pages live under /services/samh/. The 988 Florida Lifeline is Florida's DCF-governed 988 system (rule 65E-5.604); its FAQ content was verified in-run. Medicaid SUD services in Florida are delivered through Statewide Medicaid Managed Care administered by AHCA; the medicaidSud URL is AHCA's official Medicaid hub (fetched 200). The countyDirectory page is DCF's SAMH licensing page, which hosts the live searchable SUD Provider Licensing and Designation Search. Florida 211's help.fl211.org is the statewide 211 search portal (fl211.org also verified 200).
